summary.title: Source rule apply summary
summary.panelHint: Counts batch-eligible, conflicting, and protected-plan cells. Create selected / apply rules are on the right side of the canvas toolbar above the grid.
summary.readyToCreateHint: Cells that are planned, not merge-shifted, and not under a locked/protected rule span—these addresses can be created as backend points when you apply rules in batch.
summary.inConflictHint: Cells that overlap other rules or existing data and cannot be batch-created until you adjust rules, unlock protection, or resolve conflicts.
summary.protectedHint: Planned addresses covered by rules with “protect plan” enabled; batch create skips them so protected planning is not overwritten.

actions.createSelectedPointsHint: Exception-only shortcut for creating a backend point from the currently selected cell. The normal flow should still use “Apply rules” for batch creation.
actions.createRulePointsHint: Batch-create points for all planned, non-conflicting addresses derived from your rules. If conflicts remain, only the safe subset is created; the number in parentheses is how many will be created this run.

toolbar.freezeLiveHint: Pause live updates on the canvas and keep the current runtime readings visible for comparison or screenshots. Use “Resume live” to follow the stream again.
toolbar.unfreezeLiveHint: Unfreeze so cell values update from the runtime stream again.
toolbar.snapshotCompareHint: Capture the current live readings and freeze the grid—handy before/after rule changes for visual comparison (same freeze behavior as “Freeze live”, as a one-click snapshot).
toolbar.showAuditHint: Expand the address audit table: cells, rule ownership, and value summaries across the lattice.
toolbar.hideAuditHint: Collapse the audit table to save vertical space.
toolbar.saveTemplateHint: Save the current planner fields (start address, count, data type, view mode) as a local template for quick reuse.
toolbar.loadTemplateHint: Pick a saved local template and apply it to the planner (may warn if device capability assumptions differ).
